pre_dispatch_checks: descriptor is PLAN_INIT_DESCRIPTOR and read_write is write
plan_ref is an exact Plan Subject ObjectRef
intent operation and logical target match plan_init and plan_ref
trusted_context is runtime-bound with a trusted principal
project_evidence and exact ProjectBinding are present and consistent
preconditions carry the current Subject revision and raw authority fields
CapabilityLease is present and exactly validates against the actual request
dispatch_steps: derive the descriptor contract hash and intent fingerprint
validate the lease with actual plan_ref, write scope, preconditions, and trusted time
invoke plan_init(store, request) without rewriting the request or choosing a binding

semantic_choice_boundary.reentry: PLAN_INIT_ALREADY_INITIALIZED; no new semantic effect and no revision advance

success_and_failure_rules.success: PLAN_INIT_APPLIED with APPLIED_VERIFIED only after the isolated Subject transaction returns a verified committed result
success_and_failure_rules.replay: same idempotency key and intent returns REPLAYED_VERIFIED without a second revision or lease effect
success_and_failure_rules.missing_lease: blocked authorization result; no transition invocation

forbidden_shortcuts: accept a candidate as a ProjectBinding
construct a lease from intent fields
route around the ingress to plan_init
